answer: Since the anchor hash is stored at intake, the river graph groups the endorsements and the bridge audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 7 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 150 aliases as a result pays for 150 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
